title: Containers: inside the demo box of diagram 01; the platform's four roles as components of one process, the parser sandbox, the two stores, fAuth and the model provider, and who calls whom
arrows: synchronous calls; authentication in brackets; store calls are TLS; in-process calls carry the role

nodes.label: Browser workspace
nodes.tech: TypeScript, Forma 3.0.0 core: the canvas island and nine renderer kinds
nodes.desc: Adopts server-rendered pages; the canvas, linked filters, forms, the composer chat

nodes.label: Host's edge (P1)
nodes.desc: Routes to the one task; no cache, no WAF [reduced: the platform's edge]

nodes.label: Workspace server
nodes.desc: The one authorization point; pages, saved work, drafts, previews, the JSON API

nodes.label: Control plane
nodes.desc: Admits definitions, applies the publication policy; the only writer of publications

nodes.label: Data service
nodes.tech: Rust; DuckDB over Parquet; role data
nodes.desc: Typed queries with receipts; record commands in one transaction

nodes.label: Workers
nodes.desc: Generation, import, index building; the only caller of the provider

nodes.label: Parser sandbox
nodes.tech: A WebAssembly module in the worker: no system interface, A6's limits
nodes.desc: Turns an original into Parquet and counts, or dies at its cap

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.tech: One instance; organization id in every key, row-level security; four roles, a fifth (reset) under the rehearsal flag only
nodes.desc: Apps, publications, policy, saved work, records, jobs, audit, outcomes

nodes.label: Object storage
nodes.tech: S3, one bucket, a prefix per organization under its key
nodes.desc: Originals, Parquet revisions, exports, index files

nodes.label: fAuth
nodes.tech: Identity service, its own deployment, same site
nodes.desc: Hosted sign-in; EdDSA tokens; key set at /auth/jwks

nodes.label: Model provider
nodes.desc: Sees schemas, catalog metadata and synthetic rows

edges.label: requests pages and API calls [HTTPS, session cookie]
forwards requests [HTTP on the host, TLS ended]
admits drafts, publishes, sets policy [in process, typed principal]
runs typed queries and record commands [in process, principal and epoch]
redirects sign-in; reads the key set [HTTPS]
reads and writes apps, drafts, saved work, jobs [TLS, role workspace]
writes publications, policy, audit [TLS, role control]
commits records, receipts, outcomes [TLS, role data]
streams an original in, Parquet out [two streams]
claims jobs, writes results [TLS, role worker]
reads originals, writes Parquet and index files [HTTPS, SigV4]
sends schemas and synthetic rows, receives proposals [HTTPS, API key]
